experiment.name: legalbench_xai_cslaw_v2_credit
experiment.description: LeXAIBench v2 (CS&Law revision) run of the four-dataset credit benchmark (HELOC, South German Credit, Default of Credit Card Clients, Give Me Some Credit). cslaw.corrections=v2 turns on every correction in benchmark/src/legalbench_xai/corrections.py: model-native contributions, one common faithfulness reference without the self-reported quality term, counterfactual reasons from the features the counterfactuals change, non-actionable features blocked in the counterfactual search, the PAY_AMT reason-grouping fix, exponent-notation parsing, seeded random sampling within decision-margin strata, persisted CSS sub-components and data provenance. It uses the v2 feature taxonomy and dataset registry and 24 adverse cases per dataset-track-model configuration. It also persists canonical explanations and native contributions and records Reg B reference means. All other settings match experiment_four_dataset_real_highbudget.json. cslaw.null_baselines.faithfulness_reference stays 'self' on purpose: under corrections v2 the common native reference overrides it for scoring, and the null baseline's own weights are kept as metadata.faithfulness_evidence.self_reference_signed_contributions (self_source 'self').
